title: Alondra1 note document (v1)
description: The canonical rich-text form of a note: a ProseMirror/Tiptap-style JSON node tree shared by the Windows and Android apps (alondra1-notes-editor docs/DOCUMENT-FORMAT.md). HTML is only produced for clipboard and export. A document with a higher schemaVersion than a client supports is shown read-only and never rewritten.

node.description: A document node. Known types (schema version 1): paragraph, text, heading (attrs.level 1-3), blockquote, codeBlock, horizontalRule, hardBreak, bulletList, orderedList (attrs.start), listItem, taskList, taskItem (attrs.checked: boolean), table, tableRow, tableHeader, tableCell (attrs.colspan, rowspan, colwidth, backgroundColor), image. paragraph and heading may carry attrs.textAlign (left|center|right|justify), attrs.indent (1-8) and attrs.spacing (compact|relaxed). Unknown types are allowed and must be kept unchanged by clients that do not understand them.

mark.description: Known marks: bold, italic, underline, strike, code, link (attrs.href: http, https, mailto, tel or alondra:// only), textStyle (attrs.color, fontSize like '14pt', fontFamily), highlight (attrs.color). Unknown marks must be kept unchanged.

remoteSrc.description: A picture pasted from the web that the user has not loaded yet (never fetched automatically).

imageAttrs.description: Pictures reference a separately stored asset by SHA-256; image data is never embedded in the document.
